lore: <gray>Break blocks in any mine.|<gray>Drops go straight to your backpack.|<gray>Fortune multiplies drops - block density cancels it out.
<gray>Resources stack without limit.|<gray>Open it with /backpack or from the menu.|<gray>Shops spend from it directly.
<gray>Trade resources at shop NPCs for better gear.|<gray>One linear path - each pick beats the last.|<gray>Better gear unlocks harder blocks.
<gray>Mobs spawn in their own areas.|<gray>Some upgrades need mob drops as well as ore.
<gray>Each island is a region with its own blocks.|<gray>Clear a region to unlock the next one.
